name: Fandom Master
summary:
Fandom Master is a free, browser-based trading card game built around characters from a variety of manga and anime universes, including One Piece, Naruto, Dragon Ball, Jujutsu Kaisen, Bleach, and many more.

Collect cards, open boosters, complete your collections, unlock achievements, and discover different card rarities. But collecting isn't the only thing you can do.

You can also challenge other players through character-based quizzes and battles, trade cards with friends, participate in auctions, climb the leaderboards, and showcase your collection. Share your best drops with your club, and gather to defeat strong opponents. A new infinite raid is here to challenge your managing skills.

The game is free to play, with no ads or in-game purchases according to its creators.

Whether you're here to complete your favourite universe, test your knowledge, or simply enjoy collecting characters from different series, there's plenty to explore. Many more improvements are still to come.
